title: Module Analysis Cache
description: Schema for AI-generated per-module analysis output (SKILL.md Step 4). Written incrementally after each module is analyzed; consumed by Steps 5 and 8.

cache_schema_version.description: Schema version, matches CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION in common.py

modules.description: Map of module-name -> ModuleAnalysis. Keys match the module names in structure.json.

module_path.description: Relative path of the module root (e.g. 'src/auth')

code_purpose.description: CodePurpose determined for this module (dominant purpose across files)

analysis_depth.description: Highest analysis depth applied to any file in this module

module_summary.description: 1-2 sentence summary of module responsibility and architecture role

selected_components.description: Document components selected for this module (from components.md). Step 8 uses this directly without re-deciding.

dependency_hints.description: Lightweight dependency summary extracted during Step 4, used as Step 5 base input

imports.description: Module names this module imports/depends on

imported_by.description: Module names that import this module (reverse deps)

semantic_group.description: AI free-text annotation of this module's semantic theme, used as soft signal for menu grouping (e.g. '认证与鉴权', '消息路由', 'Data Persistence'). Named after reader-facing concepts, NOT CodePurpose enums.

semantic_group_confidence.description: high = module has a clear, distinct semantic boundary; low = AI is uncertain (overlapping responsibilities or unclear scope). Step 7 reduces grouping weight for low-confidence entries.

files.description: Per-file analysis results for files in this module

path.description: Relative file path from project root

complexity_score.description: Complexity score from structure.json (used for analysis depth selection)

summary.description: 1-2 sentence description of what this file does and why it exists

internal_dependencies.description: Intra-module dependencies (other files in same module this file imports)

design_patterns.description: Detected design patterns (e.g. singleton, strategy, observer)

key_insights.description: 2-5 bullet points explaining WHY the code is designed this way (design intent, trade-offs)

confidence.description: Confidence level of the analysis. high=direct source evidence, medium=inferred from structure, low=inferred from naming

signature.description: Full signature string (e.g. 'def login(username: str, password: str) -> Token')

description.description: What this interface does and when to use it (min 1 sentence)
